### Release Notes

<summary>jdx/mise-action</summary>

###
[`v5.2.5`](https://redirect.github.com/jdx/mise-action/releases/tag/v5.2.5):
: Bundled packslip verifier updated to 1.11.0; README examples use v5

[Compare
Source](https://redirect.github.com/jdx/mise-action/compare/v5.2.4...v5.2.5)

This release updates the packslip library that the action uses to verify
downloaded mise releases, and updates the README examples to use the
current major versions.

#### Changed

- **packslip updated from 1.8.0 to 1.11.0.** The action uses packslip to
check a downloaded mise binary against the signed
`packslip.sigstore.json` that ships with mise releases from 2026.9.3
onward. The new version runs extra checks on the signed statement: the
identity it declares must match the certificate that signed it, and the
certificate must belong to the `github.com/jdx/mise` repository. GitHub
and GitLab repository names now match regardless of letter case. The
action still asks for the same identity, issuer and tag as before, and
there are no new inputs.
([#​715](https://redirect.github.com/jdx/mise-action/pull/715))
- The README examples now use `jdx/mise-action@v5` and
`actions/checkout@v7`.
([#​710](https://redirect.github.com/jdx/mise-action/pull/710) by
[@​deining](https://redirect.github.com/deining))

**Full Changelog**:
<https://github.com/jdx/mise-action/compare/v5.2.4...v5.2.5>

</details>
